title: Annotatio V §.IV open: Reformed impugn third invented corporal-oral eating — three argument genera from Scripture
pass_a_gloss: §. IV. The Reformed impugn by a triple kind of arguments the Third and newly devised Eating of CHRIST’s Body — namely the Corporal and Oral, which yet is merely Supernatural and in no way Natural or Physical — of which the first is from the Nature of Christ’s Body to be eaten; the Second from the Nature of those who by right are Eaters; and finally the Third from the nature of the Oral Eating itself. All are sought from Sacred Scripture itself and rest on its testimonies.
pass_b_english: §.IV: the Reformed attack the third newly invented Eating of Christ’s Body — corporal and oral, yet claimed merely supernatural, not natural/physical.
Three argument genera from Scripture: (1) nature of the Body to be eaten; (2) nature of those who by right eat; (3) nature of Oral eating itself.
source_text: §. IV. Reformati Tertiam noviterque excogitatam Manducationem Corporis CHRISTI, Corporalem scilicet Oralemque, quæ tamen merè Supernaturalis, nec ullo modo Naturalis aut Physica sit, triplici argumentorum genere impugnant, quorum primum à Natura Corporis Christi manducandi; Alterum à Natura de jure Manducantium; Tertium denique à Manducationis ipsius Oralis natura. Cuncta ex ipsâ S. Scripturâ petita sunt & hujus testimoniis innituntur.

lemmas.gloss: by a triple kind of arguments

notes: §.IV open: three genera vs invented corporal-oral.
